stories.title: Volley, è morta Stefania Corna. Giocò in A1 e con la Nazionale. Aveva 35 anni

en.title: Volley, Stefania Corna has died. She played in A1 and for the National team. She was 35 years old
en.summary: A setter who played for top-tier Italian volleyball clubs Bergamo and Scandicci and represented the national team has died at age 35. The volleyball community is mourning her loss.

stories.title: Mattarella firma tre provvedimenti di grazia, c'è anche il gioielliere Guido Gianni

en.title: Mattarella signs three pardons, including jeweler Guido Gianni
en.summary: The Italian President granted partial pardons to three individuals, including a jeweler convicted in 2008 for killing two robbers during a theft. The pardon reduced his sentence by three years and two months.

stories.title: È morta Maricarmen, il volto delle proteste per diritto alla casa in Spagna

en.title: Maricarmen, face of housing rights protests in Spain, has died
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman who became a prominent figure in Spanish housing rights activism died in a hospital following her eviction from her home. The eviction concluded a lengthy legal battle against an investment fund.

stories.title: E' morta Maricarmen, il volto delle proteste per il diritto alla casa in Spagna

en.title: Maricarmen, the face of housing rights protests in Spain, has died
en.summary: An 87-year-old housing rights activist died in a hospital following her eviction after a prolonged legal dispute with an investment fund. Spain's Prime Minister and political parties paid their respects.

stories.title: Spagna, è morta Maricarmen: simbolo della protesta per la casa

en.title: Spain, Maricarmen dies: symbol of housing protest
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman evicted from her Madrid home in September has died. Her case mobilized the country and contributed to a government crisis.

stories.title: Mattarella firma tre provvedimenti di grazia parziale: tra i destinatari il gioielliere Guido Gianni

en.title: Mattarella grants three partial pardons: jeweler Guido Gianni among recipients
en.summary: President Mattarella has granted three partial pardons. Jeweler Guido Gianni, sentenced to over twelve years for two killings committed during a 2008 robbery attempt, is among the beneficiaries.

stories.title: Mattarella grants three pardons, jeweler Guido Gianni among recipients

en.title: Mattarella grants three pardons, jeweler Guido Gianni among recipients
en.summary: President Mattarella has granted three pardons. Jeweler Guido Gianni, who killed two robbers during a 2008 heist and received a 13-year sentence, is among those receiving clemency.

stories.title: Mattarella ha firmato tre grazie, c'è anche il gioielliere Guido Gianni

en.title: Mattarella has signed three pardons, jeweler Guido Gianni included
en.summary: President Mattarella has signed three individual clemency decrees, with jeweler Guido Gianni among the recipients.

stories.title: Spagna, è morta Maricarmen: il suo sfratto ha innescato le proteste per il diritto alla casa

en.title: Spain: Maricarmen dies; her eviction sparked housing rights protests
en.summary: A woman whose eviction triggered nationwide protests over housing rights in Spain has died. Her case became a focal point for demonstrations demanding better access to housing.

stories.title: Mattarella concede tre grazie: c’è anche Guido Gianni, il gioielliere che uccise i due rapinatori

en.title: Mattarella grants three pardons: including jeweler Guido Gianni who killed two robbers
en.summary: Italy's President Mattarella has pardoned three individuals, including a jeweler previously sentenced to twelve years for killing two robbers in self-defense. Political figures across parties praised the decision.

stories.title: Mattarella concede tre grazie: c’è anche il gioielliere che uccise i rapinatori nel 2008

en.title: Mattarella grants three pardons: including the jeweler who killed robbers in 2008
en.summary: President Mattarella has signed three presidential pardons under constitutional provisions, one involving a jeweler convicted for killing robbers during an incident in 2008.

stories.title: Grave l’attore Davide Iacopini, aggredito mentre era in monopattino. Caccia alla banda della minicar

en.title: Actor Davide Iacopini seriously injured, attacked while on scooter. Hunt for minicar gang
en.summary: Actor Davide Iacopini was kicked off his scooter on October 5 and remains hospitalized in intensive care. Authorities are investigating similar incidents in Rome's Monteverde neighborhood.

stories.title: Mudec, i dodici anni del Gruppo Il Sole 24 ORE fra arte e impresa

en.title: Mudec, twelve years of Il Sole 24 ORE Group between art and business
en.summary: The Mudec museum, managed by Il Sole 24 ORE for twelve years, has hosted 57 exhibitions and attracted 3.2 million visitors, with extensive educational programming for students.

stories.title: Teatro alla Scala, frizioni sul rinnovo del contratto

en.title: Teatro alla Scala, friction over contract renewal
en.summary: Major unions have declared a state of agitation regarding contract negotiations at Teatro alla Scala. A key point of contention is a proposed 15% increase in annual compensation.

stories.title: Sicilia, termovalorizzatori: c’è l’ok della Cts

en.title: Sicily, waste-to-energy plants: CTS approval granted
en.summary: Sicily has moved forward with waste-to-energy facilities in Palermo and Catania after receiving favorable approval from the specialized technical commission for environmental authorizations.

stories.title: Missione nel Golfo, Urso a Doha: tecnologie strategiche e Made in Italy al centro dell’intesa con il Qatar

en.title: Gulf mission, Urso in Doha: strategic technologies and Made in Italy at center of Qatar agreement
en.summary: The Italian government is directing Qatari investment toward strategic sectors including artificial intelligence, data centers, quantum computing, advanced robotics, and critical raw materials.

stories.title: Asfalto, il caro energia moltiplica i costi

en.title: Asphalt, expensive energy multiplies costs
en.summary: Asphalt production value reached 4 billion euros with output of 34.8 million tonnes, up 3.6 percent compared to 2025. Rising energy costs have significantly increased production expenses.
